text_block_list.text:
в тренировке, Юкино Бидзин drops by to
bring us
some bottles of refreshing
water.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She says the way Голд Сити runs is
beautiful, but
Gold City complains she'd
rather be told she was
strong.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Юкино Бидзин insists that by "beautiful"
she's not
referring only to Голд Сити's
looks. Instead, it
describes everything
about her, including her
strength and
amazing skill.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити thinks back and laughs.
Perhaps this is
what some people had
meant when talking about
her all along.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As Голд Сити gives a hearty laugh,
Юкино Бидзин
tells her that she's more
beautiful than ever, and
Gold City
agrees that she likes herself better
now,
too.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
